title: Religion Is a Team Sport
supportablePoints: Religion is likely treated as group-binding technology rather than only a truth-claim system.
The chapter likely builds on the hive switch by asking which institutions trigger and organize coordinated moral life.
Religion should remain morally double-edged rather than automatically noble or automatically false.
unsupportedZones: truth-value adjudication beyond the frozen bundle
flattening religion into only fraud, only doctrine, or only tribalism
